meta.name: PhysAlts Curated Flagships
meta.description: Authoritative curated global physics hubs uniting all 50 core flagships and 20 additional regional & underrepresented-country institutions.

hubs.name: CERN
hubs.summary: Home of the 27 km Large Hadron Collider, smashing protons at 99.999999% the speed of light to probe the building blocks of matter.
hubs.nobel: Confirmed the Higgs boson (2012) and W/Z bosons (Rubbia & van der Meer, 1984).

stages.highschool: Beamline for Schools competition (run your own real particle beam experiment at CERN) & Science Gateway.
stages.undergrad: Paid CERN Summer Student Programme (8–13 weeks) & Technical Studentships (4–14 months).
stages.masters: CERN Doctoral/Master's thesis placements via member-state universities & Technical Studentships.
stages.phd: CERN Doctoral Student Programme (up to 36 months) or join ATLAS/CMS/LHCb via your home PhD.
stages.postdoc: CERN Research Fellowships (2–3 years) in experimental or theoretical particle physics.
stages.assoc_prof: Scientific Associate sabbaticals (1–12 months) & physics working-group convenerships.
stages.prof: Experiment Spokesperson, Collaboration Board leadership, and Visiting Scientist chairs.

hubs.name: IceCube Neutrino Observatory
hubs.summary: A cubic-kilometer neutrino telescope buried 2 km beneath Antarctic ice, catching ghostly particles from distant black holes.
hubs.nobel: Pioneered high-energy neutrino astronomy across 58 partner universities worldwide.

stages.highschool: IceCube Masterclasses (analyze real South Pole neutrino events with physicists).
stages.undergrad: NSF REU at UW–Madison WIPAC or summer projects at DESY, RWTH Aachen, or Geneva.
stages.masters: MSc thesis inside any of the 58 IceCube member universities (e.g. TU Munich, RWTH Aachen, Uppsala).
stages.phd: PhD in astroparticle physics; opportunity to deploy hardware at the South Pole during Austral summer.
stages.postdoc: WIPAC / DESY / IceCube-Gen2 postdoctoral fellowships leading real-time multimessenger alerts.
stages.assoc_prof: Institution PI leading an IceCube-Gen2 instrumentation or analysis working group.
stages.prof: Collaboration Spokesperson & multi-national NSF/BMBF infrastructure leadership.

hubs.name: MIT Physics
hubs.summary: Consistently ranked among the world's foremost physics departments; co-built LIGO, leads compact fusion research, and pioneers ultracold quantum matter.
hubs.nobel: 30+ physics laureates including Rainer Weiss (LIGO 2017) and Wolfgang Ketterle (2001).

stages.highschool: MIT RSI (Research Science Institute) summer program & MIT OpenCourseWare 8.01–8.04.
stages.undergrad: MIT Summer Research Program (MSRP) paid summer research for visiting undergrads.
stages.masters: MIT admits directly to the fully funded PhD from undergrad (SM awarded along the way).
stages.phd: 5–6 year fully funded PhD in Quantum, Astro, Nuclear, Condensed Matter, or Theory.
stages.postdoc: Pappalardo Fellowships in Physics (3-year independent flagship postdoc).
stages.assoc_prof: Tenure-track / Associate Professor faculty searches across MIT's four physics divisions.
stages.prof: Endowed chairs, Kavli Institute / RLE / LNS directorships, and visiting professorships.

projects.name: MIT Plasma Science and Fusion Center (PSFC)

hubs.name: ETH Zurich Physics
hubs.summary: Albert Einstein's alma mater on Hönggerberg campus—one of Europe's cleanest, most affordable English-taught physics Master's.
hubs.nobel: 20+ Nobel laureates including Einstein, Wolfgang Pauli, Felix Bloch, and Didier Queloz.

stages.highschool: Swiss Physics Olympiad & ETH Youth Academy public lectures.
stages.undergrad: ETH Student Summer Research Fellowship & direct application to the English MSc.
stages.masters: 90 ECTS English MSc (~CHF 730/semester); Excellence Scholarship (ESOP) covers full living costs.
stages.phd: Salaried Swiss PhD positions (~CHF 50k+/yr) in Quantum Center, Particle, or Astro groups.
stages.postdoc: ETH Zurich Postdoctoral Fellowships & Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) Ambizione.
stages.assoc_prof: SNSF Eccellenza / ERC Consolidator & ETH Tenure-Track Assistant/Associate Professorships.
stages.prof: Full Professor chairs at D-PHYS & Pauli Center for Theoretical Studies.

hubs.name: LIGO Hanford
hubs.summary: Two 4 km laser arms in the Washington desert that heard spacetime ripple from colliding black holes a billion light-years away.
hubs.nobel: Rainer Weiss, Barry Barish & Kip Thorne (2017 Nobel Prize in Physics).

stages.highschool: GWOSC Open Data workshops & LIGO Exploration Center (LExC) hands-on interferometry.
stages.undergrad: Caltech LIGO SURF 10-week paid summer research fellowships at Hanford, Livingston, or Caltech.
stages.masters: MSc projects in gravitational-wave data analysis or quantum squeezing via LVK partner universities.
stages.phd: PhD at Caltech, MIT, or 100+ LIGO Scientific Collaboration universities worldwide.
stages.postdoc: LIGO Laboratory Postdocs & NASA Einstein Fellowships in gravitational-wave astrophysics.
stages.assoc_prof: LVK Observational Science / Instrumentation working-group leadership.
stages.prof: Cosmic Explorer & LISA next-generation observatory executive leadership.

hubs.name: Paris-Saclay Physics
hubs.summary: Europe's top-ranked continental physics cluster, uniting CNRS, CEA Saclay, SOLEIL synchrotron, and Alain Aspect's quantum optics legacy.
hubs.nobel: Alain Aspect (2022 quantum entanglement), Albert Fert (2007), Pierre-Gilles de Gennes (1991).

stages.highschool: Fête de la Science open-lab days at Institut d'Optique and SOLEIL.
stages.undergrad: Paid French lab stages (internships) at CNRS / CEA Saclay labs.
stages.masters: English MSc in Quantum, Astro, or Fundamental Physics with €10,000/yr IDEX scholarships.
stages.phd: Funded French Contrat Doctoral across EDPIF / PHENIICS doctoral schools.
stages.postdoc: CNRS / CEA Saclay & MSCA postdoctoral fellowships.
stages.assoc_prof: Maître de Conférences (MCF) or CNRS Chargé de Recherche permanent research posts.
stages.prof: CNRS Directeur de Recherche & Professeur des Universités chairs.

hubs.name: Oxford Physics
hubs.summary: One of the world's leading physics departments—a powerhouse in quantum computing, cosmology, atmospheric physics, and mathematical theory.
hubs.nobel: Roger Penrose (2020 black hole theorems) and Anthony Leggett (2003).

stages.highschool: British Physics Olympiad (hosted at Oxford) & UNIQ summer school.
stages.undergrad: Oxford Physics Summer Internships & visiting student terms.
stages.masters: 1-year MSc in Mathematical & Theoretical Physics with Clarendon & Rhodes scholarships.
stages.phd: 3.5–4 year DPhil across 6 sub-departments (Astro, Atomic, Condensed, Particle, Theory, AOPP).
stages.postdoc: Royal Society University Research Fellowships & Oxford College Junior Research Fellowships (JRFs).
stages.assoc_prof: Associate Professor of Physics coupled with a Tutorial Fellowship at an Oxford College.
stages.prof: Statutory Chairs (e.g., Wykeham / Rouse Ball / Savilian Professorships).

projects.name: UK National Quantum Computing Centre Hub
Beecroft Institute for Particle Astrophysics and Cosmology

hubs.name: Cavendish Laboratory
hubs.summary: Where the electron, neutron, and DNA structure were discovered—now housing the brand-new Ray Dolby Centre.
hubs.nobel: 30 Nobel laureates including J.J. Thomson, Rutherford, Paul Dirac, and Didier Queloz.

stages.highschool: Isaac Physics problem-solving platform (built at Cavendish) & Senior Physics Challenge.
stages.undergrad: Cavendish Undergraduate Research Opportunities Programme (UROP).
stages.masters: 1-year MASt in Physics (Part III) or MPhil with Gates Cambridge full funding.
stages.phd: Funded PhD at Cavendish / DAMTP / Institute of Astronomy.
stages.postdoc: Herchel Smith & College Junior Research Fellowships.
stages.assoc_prof: University Associate Professor in Experimental or Theoretical Physics.
stages.prof: Cavendish Professor of Physics & Maxwell Centre research leadership.

hubs.name: University of Tokyo Physics
hubs.summary: Asia's premier fundamental physics department—operating Super-Kamiokande, KAGRA gravitational waves, and Kavli IPMU.
hubs.nobel: Takaaki Kajita (2015), Masatoshi Koshiba (2002), Yoichiro Nambu (2008), Syukuro Manabe (2021).

stages.highschool: UTokyo Global Science Course outreach & Kavli IPMU public lectures.
stages.undergrad: UTokyo Amgen / UTRIP 6-week paid summer research internship for international undergrads.
stages.masters: English GSGC Master's/PhD track with full MEXT government scholarship & stipend.
stages.phd: Funded 3-year PhD at Hongo campus, ICRR, ISSP, or Kavli IPMU.
stages.postdoc: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowship for Research in Japan & Kavli IPMU Fellowships.
stages.assoc_prof: Associate Professor appointments in School of Science or Kavli IPMU.
stages.prof: Full Professor & Principal Investigator roles leading Hyper-K / KAGRA.

hubs.name: Super-Kamiokande
hubs.summary: A gleaming cathedral of 11,000 golden photomultipliers holding 50,000 tons of ultrapure water 1 km inside a Japanese mountain.
hubs.nobel: Two Nobel Prizes (2002 & 2015) for supernova neutrinos and proving neutrinos have mass.

stages.highschool: Kamioka Lab VR virtual tour & public neutrino observatory center.
stages.undergrad: Summer neutrino data-analysis projects via UTRIP or T2K/Hyper-K partner labs.
stages.masters: University of Tokyo ICRR English MSc (GSGC/MEXT) working directly on Super-K / Hyper-K.
stages.phd: PhD with ICRR Tokyo, Kyoto, or international Hyper-Kamiokande collaboration groups.
stages.postdoc: ICRR & JSPS postdocs commissioning the 260,000-ton Hyper-Kamiokande detector.
stages.assoc_prof: Collaboration run-coordinator & detector subsystem PI.
stages.prof: Hyper-Kamiokande international spokesperson & national funding leadership.

hubs.name: Perimeter Institute
hubs.summary: An architectural glass sanctuary dedicated purely to foundational theory—quantum gravity, cosmology, and quantum foundations.
hubs.nobel: Visiting chairs include Roger Penrose and Juan Maldacena; Event Horizon Telescope hub.

stages.highschool: ISSYP (International Summer School for Young Physicists) — 2-week intensive theoretical physics camp.
stages.undergrad: Undergraduate Theoretical Physics Summer Program (paid 4-month research stay).
stages.masters: Perimeter Scholars International (PSI): 1-year 100% funded Master's covering tuition, meals & housing.
stages.phd: Funded PhD jointly with University of Waterloo, supervised by Perimeter faculty.
stages.postdoc: 3-year Perimeter Postdoctoral Fellowships (quantum gravity, cosmology, quantum matter).
stages.assoc_prof: Junior Faculty / Associate Faculty chairs with zero mandatory undergraduate teaching load.
stages.prof: Senior Faculty & Distinguished Visiting Research Chairs.

hubs.name: QuTech & TU Delft
hubs.summary: Building fault-tolerant silicon & superconducting quantum processors alongside Europe's first multi-node quantum internet.
hubs.nobel: Delivered the first loophole-free Bell test of quantum entanglement (2015).

stages.highschool: Quantum Inspire (run real quantum circuits online on QuTech's Starmon processors).
stages.undergrad: QuTech Academy free edX courses & summer lab visits.
stages.masters: 2-year English MSc in Applied Physics or Quantum Information Science & Technology (QIST).
stages.phd: Salaried 4-year Dutch PhD employee contracts with full benefits.
stages.postdoc: QuTech / NWO Veni postdoc grants building multi-node quantum repeaters.
stages.assoc_prof: TU Delft Tenure-Track / Associate Professor + NWO Vidi / ERC Consolidator.
stages.prof: QuTech Division Director & Full Professor of Quantum Engineering.

hubs.name: ASML (EUV Physics)
hubs.summary: The only company on Earth building 13.5 nm Extreme Ultraviolet lithography machines—shooting lasers at molten tin droplets 50,000 times/sec.
hubs.nobel: Industrial pinnacle of plasma physics, Bragg multilayer mirrors, and picometer optics.

stages.highschool: ASML Junior Academy & STEM robotics / optics challenges.
stages.undergrad: ASML Technology Scholarships & 6-month paid engineering/physics internships.
stages.masters: Paid MSc graduation thesis projects in EUV optics, plasma, or metrology.
stages.phd: Direct R&D physicist recruitment or joint industrial PhDs with ARCNL Amsterdam.
stages.postdoc: Senior Design Engineer / Research Scientist roles (High-NA EUV).
stages.assoc_prof: Joint academic-industry research collaborations via ARCNL & TU Eindhoven.
stages.prof: ASML Fellow / Principal Architect or academic advisory board.

projects.name: High-NA EUV Lithography (0.55 NA TWINSCAN EXE)

hubs.name: ITER Fusion Tokamak
hubs.summary: A 35-nation mega-engineering effort in southern France assembling the largest superconducting tokamak ever built to tame star-core fusion.
hubs.nobel: Unites EU, USA, Japan, South Korea, India, China, and Russia on burning-plasma physics.

stages.highschool: ITER virtual tours & European Fusion Education Network (FuseNet) high-school modules.
stages.undergrad: Paid ITER undergraduate internships (up to 6 months) in cryogenics, magnets, or plasma.
stages.masters: Erasmus Mundus FUSION-EP Joint Master's with direct thesis links to ITER & CEA WEST.
stages.phd: EUROfusion / FuseNet funded PhDs in tokamak burning-plasma physics.
stages.postdoc: ITER Monaco Postdoctoral Fellowships (2-year international fusion fellowships).
stages.assoc_prof: ITPA (International Tokamak Physics Activity) topical-group leadership.
stages.prof: ITER Science Division leadership & national fusion program directors.

hubs.name: Commonwealth Fusion (SPARC)
hubs.summary: MIT spinout constructing SPARC, a compact high-field tokamak powered by 20-tesla high-temperature superconducting magnets.
hubs.nobel: Turns Bednorz & Müller's 1987 Nobel superconductivity discovery into compact fusion magnets.

stages.highschool: MIT PSFC fusion outreach & virtual SPARC magnet demonstrations.
stages.undergrad: Paid undergrad co-ops in plasma physics, cryogenics, and HTS magnet testing.
stages.masters: MSc engineering & applied-physics roles on SPARC diagnostics and ARC power plant.
stages.phd: Joint research PhDs with MIT Plasma Science & Fusion Center (PSFC).
stages.postdoc: Staff Plasma Physicist & Magnet Scientist roles at Devens HQ.
stages.assoc_prof: Collaborative burning-plasma modeling grants with CFS & DOE.
stages.prof: Scientific Advisory Board & multi-institution fusion consortia.

hubs.name: Fermilab
hubs.summary: America's premier particle physics campus—iconic Wilson Hall, restored prairie with bison, and the upcoming DUNE neutrino beam.
hubs.nobel: Discovered the bottom quark (1977), top quark (1995), and tau neutrino (2000).

stages.highschool: TARGET & QuarkNet high-school summer physics internships.
stages.undergrad: Paid international undergrad internships (SIST, IPM, DOE SULI).
stages.masters: MSc thesis placements via DUNE & CMS partner universities.
stages.phd: URA Visiting Scholars & Fermilab Joint PhD Fellowships.
stages.postdoc: Lederman Fellowship & Wilson Fellowship (flagship 3–5 year postdocs).
stages.assoc_prof: Fermilab Associate Scientist & DUNE consortium leadership.
stages.prof: Fermilab Distinguished Scientist & DOE HEPAP advisory panels.

hubs.name: SLAC & Stanford
hubs.summary: A 3.2 km linear accelerator slicing straight across California hills, now driving LCLS-II to film atoms in femtosecond motion.
hubs.nobel: 4 Nobel Prizes in Physics & Chemistry (quarks, charm quark, tau lepton, structural biology).

stages.highschool: SLAC SAGE-S summer camp & public virtual accelerator tours.
stages.undergrad: DOE SULI paid 10-week internships in X-ray laser science, cosmology (Rubin), or accelerators.
stages.masters: Stanford Applied Physics MS or visiting international MSc thesis projects.
stages.phd: Funded Stanford Physics / Applied Physics PhD working at LCLS-II or KIPAC.
stages.postdoc: Panofsky Fellowship & KIPAC Postdoctoral Fellowships.
stages.assoc_prof: SLAC / Stanford Photon Science & Particle Astrophysics Associate Professor.
stages.prof: Full Professor & LCLS / Rubin Observatory executive leadership.

projects.name: LSST Camera for Vera C. Rubin Observatory

hubs.name: DESY
hubs.summary: Germany's flagship accelerator center operating PETRA III and the 3.4 km European XFEL; discovered the gluon in 1979.
hubs.nobel: Proved the existence of gluons, confirming quantum chromodynamics.

stages.highschool: DESY Schülerlabor (hands-on particle & vacuum physics labs for school students).
stages.undergrad: Paid international DESY Summer Student Programme (open to all nationalities).
stages.masters: Tuition-free English MSc at University of Hamburg with paid DESY thesis work.
stages.phd: Salaried TVöD PhD contracts via PIER Helmholtz Graduate School.
stages.postdoc: DESY Fellowships (2–3 years) in Particle, Astroparticle, or Photon Science.
stages.assoc_prof: Helmholtz Young Investigator Group Leader (independent 5-year funding).
stages.prof: Lead Scientist (W3) joint professorships with University of Hamburg.

hubs.name: Max Planck Quantum Optics
hubs.summary: World epicenter of attosecond laser flashes, optical frequency combs, and ultracold quantum simulators.
hubs.nobel: Theodor Hänsch (2005 Nobel) and Ferenc Krausz (2023 Nobel for attosecond pulses).

stages.highschool: PhotonLab Munich (student laser & quantum-optics laboratory at MPQ).
stages.undergrad: Paid summer research internships & HiWi student assistant roles.
stages.masters: Tuition-free English MSc at TUM or LMU Munich with paid MPQ thesis supervision.
stages.phd: IMPRS for Quantum Science and Technology (IMPRS-QST) salaried PhDs.
stages.postdoc: MPQ / Munich Center for Quantum Science & Technology (MCQST) Fellowships.
stages.assoc_prof: Max Planck Research Group Leader (W2 independent group).
stages.prof: Max Planck Director (Scientific Member of the Max Planck Society).

projects.name: Munich Center for Quantum Science and Technology (MCQST)

hubs.name: Paul Scherrer Institute
hubs.summary: Switzerland's mega-facility hub running the Swiss Light Source, SwissFEL X-ray laser, and world-leading muon beams.
hubs.nobel: Key European center for ultracold neutrons and precision muon experiments.

stages.highschool: PSI iLab (student hands-on radioactivity, spectroscopy & vacuum lab).
stages.undergrad: Summer student internships & ETH/EPFL semester projects.
stages.masters: Joint MSc theses directly via ETH Zurich and EPFL.
stages.phd: Salaried Swiss PhDs in muon physics, X-ray lasers, and condensed matter.
stages.postdoc: PSI-FELLOW-III-3i (Marie Curie co-funded international postdoc program).
stages.assoc_prof: Beamline Group Leader & joint ETH/EPFL professorships.
stages.prof: PSI Division Head & Swiss large-facility strategy leadership.

hubs.name: ESRF Synchrotron
hubs.summary: The iconic 844 m silver synchrotron ring nestled in the French Alps, producing X-rays 100 billion times brighter than hospital scanners.
hubs.nobel: Powered Nobel Prize discoveries in ribosome and GPCR molecular physics.

stages.highschool: Synchrotron@School hands-on beamline day for high-school classes.
stages.undergrad: Paid ESRF Summer Student Programme (4 weeks in Grenoble).
stages.masters: Université Grenoble Alpes English MSc in Condensed Matter with ESRF thesis.
stages.phd: Funded 3-year ESRF PhD contracts in X-ray imaging, magnetism, and high-pressure physics.
stages.postdoc: ESRF Postdoc & Junior Beamline Scientist positions.
stages.assoc_prof: Beamline Responsible Scientist & ERC user-group PI.
stages.prof: Director of Research & European synchrotron consortia leadership.

hubs.name: European Spallation Source
hubs.summary: Europe's brand-new pulsed neutron super-microscope in southern Sweden, sitting right beside the MAX IV synchrotron.
hubs.nobel: Probes quantum magnets and high-Tc superconductors at atomic resolution.

stages.highschool: Lund Science Village outreach & virtual neutron-scattering demos.
stages.undergrad: Paid ESS & MAX IV summer internships in Sweden.
stages.masters: Lund University English MSc in Physics with ESS instrument thesis.
stages.phd: Salaried 4-year Swedish PhDs in neutron scattering and accelerator physics.
stages.postdoc: ESS Instrument Scientist & Postdoc positions.
stages.assoc_prof: Lead Instrument Scientist & Nordic neutron-science PI.
stages.prof: Science Directorate & ERIC international consortium chairs.

projects.name: ESS Pulsed Spallation Neutron Source Commissioning

hubs.name: INFN Gran Sasso
hubs.summary: Three colossal underground caverns beneath 1,400 m of Apennine rock hunting for dark matter (XENONnT) and solar neutrinos.
hubs.nobel: Detected CNO-cycle solar neutrinos and leads global dark-matter sensitivity.

stages.highschool: INFN Open Days & International Dark Matter Day school workshops.
stages.undergrad: LNGS Summer Internship Program for physics undergraduates.
stages.masters: MSc theses via Italian & international XENONnT / Borexino / LEGEND groups.
stages.phd: Gran Sasso Science Institute (GSSI) fully funded international PhD fellowships.
stages.postdoc: INFN Postdoctoral Fellowships for non-Italian & Italian citizens.
stages.assoc_prof: INFN Primo Ricercatore & underground experiment technical coordinator.
stages.prof: LNGS Director & global dark-matter collaboration spokespersons.

hubs.name: Abdus Salam ICTP
hubs.summary: Overlooking the Adriatic Sea, founded by Nobel laureate Abdus Salam to launch physicists from every country on Earth.
hubs.nobel: Founded by Abdus Salam (1979 Nobel Prize for electroweak unification).

stages.highschool: ICTP Physics Without Frontiers & open recorded lecture archive.
stages.undergrad: ICTP Summer Schools & Physics Without Frontiers regional workshops.
stages.masters: Fully funded 1-year ICTP Postgraduate Diploma bridging undergrads to top global PhDs.
stages.phd: Joint ICTP–SISSA funded PhDs in High-Energy, Condensed Matter, and Cosmology.
stages.postdoc: ICTP Postdoctoral Fellowships (2–3 years) in Trieste.
stages.assoc_prof: ICTP Regular Associateships (funded recurring research visits for faculty from developing nations).
stages.prof: ICTP Senior Associates & Research Section Heads.

hubs.name: ICFO Photonics
hubs.summary: Mediterranean research hub pushing quantum optics, graphene photonics, and quantum communication networks.
hubs.nobel: Top European ERC hub for attosecond and quantum-light experiments.

stages.highschool: ICFO Young Photonics Congress & high-school research mentorship.
stages.undergrad: Paid ICFO International Summer Fellows (open worldwide).
stages.masters: Barcelona Master in Photonics (Europhotonics Erasmus Mundus) with ICFO fellowships.
stages.phd: ICFOstepstone & La Caixa INPhINIT funded doctoral fellowships.
stages.postdoc: ICFO+ & MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships.
stages.assoc_prof: ICFO Group Leader (tenure-track) & ERC Starting/Consolidator grants.
stages.prof: ICREA Research Professor at ICFO.

hubs.name: IQM Quantum Computers
hubs.summary: Europe's superconducting quantum hardware builder, spun out of Aalto University's world-renowned low-temperature labs.
hubs.nobel: Built on Nordic milli-kelvin cryogenics and superconducting qubit physics.

stages.highschool: IQM Academy free introductory quantum computing platform.
stages.undergrad: Aalto University Science Institute (AScI) paid summer internships.
stages.masters: Aalto English MSc in Engineering Physics + paid thesis roles at IQM.
stages.phd: Industrial quantum-hardware PhDs with Aalto & VTT Finland.
stages.postdoc: Quantum Engineer / Cryogenic Physicist R&D positions in Espoo or Munich.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint European Quantum Flagship academic-industry grants.
stages.prof: Chief Quantum Scientist / Academic Advisory Board.

hubs.name: TRIUMF Cyclotron
hubs.summary: Home to the world's largest cyclotron on the forested UBC campus, producing rare isotopes and medical radioisotopes.
hubs.nobel: Key contributor to Arthur McDonald's 2015 Nobel solar-neutrino discovery.

stages.highschool: TRIUMF Saturday Morning Lectures & High School Fellowship.
stages.undergrad: Paid 4–8 month undergraduate co-op placements in nuclear & particle physics.
stages.masters: Funded MSc via UBC, SFU, or UVic conducting thesis experiments at TRIUMF.
stages.phd: Funded Canadian PhDs using ISAC / ARIEL rare-isotope beams.
stages.postdoc: TRIUMF Postdoctoral Fellowships in Nuclear, Accelerator, or Particle Physics.
stages.assoc_prof: TRIUMF Research Scientist & joint Canadian university faculty.
stages.prof: Division Head & Canada Research Chair (Tier 1).

projects.name: TUCAN Ultracold Neutron Electric Dipole Moment Search

hubs.name: KEK Accelerator Lab
hubs.summary: Operates SuperKEKB / Belle II at world-record collision luminosity to test why matter survived over antimatter.
hubs.nobel: Experimentally confirmed Kobayashi-Maskawa CP violation (2008 Nobel Prize).

stages.highschool: KEK Open Campus & Belle II virtual detector explorer.
stages.undergrad: KEK Summer Student Program (international undergrads).
stages.masters: SOKENDAI English 5-year MSc/PhD program directly inside KEK.
stages.phd: Funded SOKENDAI / Belle II / J-PARC doctoral tracks.
stages.postdoc: KEK & JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships.
stages.assoc_prof: KEK Associate Professor (IPNS / Accelerator Lab).
stages.prof: KEK Full Professor & Belle II / ILC international leadership.

projects.name: Belle II / SuperKEKB High-Luminosity Flavor Factory
J-PARC Neutrino Beamline for T2K & Hyper-K

hubs.name: RIKEN Wako
hubs.summary: Japan's flagship science institute where element 113 (Nihonium) was synthesized and superconducting quantum chips are built.
hubs.nobel: Hideki Yukawa (1949) & Shin'ichirō Tomonaga (1965) did foundational work here.

stages.highschool: RIKEN Open Day & Quantum Science outreach.
stages.undergrad: RIKEN Student Trainee summer research stays.
stages.masters: RIKEN International Program Associate (IPA) for MSc/PhD students.
stages.phd: Paid RIKEN Junior Research Associate (JRA) & IPA fellowships.
stages.postdoc: RIKEN Special Postdoctoral Researchers (SPDR — 3-year flagship grant).
stages.assoc_prof: RIKEN Hakubi Team Leader (independent 5–7 year lab startup).
stages.prof: RIKEN Chief Scientist & Center Director (CEMS / RQC / Nishina).

hubs.name: KAIST Physics
hubs.summary: South Korea's top science university, leading axion dark-matter searches, metamaterials, and quantum optics.
hubs.nobel: Hosts flagship Institute for Basic Science (IBS) fundamental physics centers.

stages.highschool: KAIST International Undergraduate Admission (full tuition + stipend).
stages.undergrad: KAIST Summer Research Internships in Physics & IBS Centers.
stages.masters: 100% English MS/PhD with KAIST International Scholarship (tuition + monthly stipend).
stages.phd: Funded PhD with KAIST & IBS Center for Axion and Precision Physics.
stages.postdoc: IBS Research Fellow & KAIST Postdoc fellowships.
stages.assoc_prof: Tenure-track / Associate Professor (international English-taught faculty).
stages.prof: Full Professor & IBS Center Director.

projects.name: IBS Center for Axion and Precision Physics Research (CAPP)

hubs.name: Centre for Quantum Tech
hubs.summary: Asia's premier quantum physics center building orbital quantum-encryption satellites and trapped-ion atomic clocks.
hubs.nobel: Founded by Artur Ekert, inventor of entanglement-based quantum cryptography.

stages.highschool: CQT Quantum Shorts & Singapore Physics Olympiad mentorship.
stages.undergrad: Paid international undergrad internships in quantum optics & information.
stages.masters: NUS MSc in Physics with CQT research projects.
stages.phd: Fully funded CQT PhD Scholarships (open to all nationalities).
stages.postdoc: CQT Research Fellow & Lee Kuan Yew Postdoctoral Fellowships.
stages.assoc_prof: NRF Fellowship (up to S$3M independent 5-year research grant).
stages.prof: CQT Principal Investigator & NRF Investigatorship.

hubs.name: IISc Bengaluru
hubs.summary: India's top fundamental research campus—a green sanctuary of condensed matter, 2D materials, and astrophysics.
hubs.nobel: C.V. Raman (1930 Nobel Prize in Physics) served as its first Indian Director.

stages.highschool: IISc 4-year BS (Research) in Physics admission.
stages.undergrad: Indian Academy of Sciences Summer Research Fellowship at IISc.
stages.masters: Integrated PhD / MSc in Physical Sciences (English) with stipend.
stages.phd: Funded PhD in Condensed Matter, Astro, High-Energy, or Quantum Tech.
stages.postdoc: C.V. Raman Postdoctoral Fellowship & Ramanujan Fellowship.
stages.assoc_prof: Associate Professor in Department of Physics or CHEP.
stages.prof: Full Professor & National Science Chair.
